responsibility: This file implements mc’s lightweight internal debugging support. Its assert routine escalates failed invariants into mcError internal errors tagged with compiler source location, while writeDebug conditionally emits trace text when the internal-debugging option is enabled. It provides the common low-level assertion path used across collection, lexer-buffer, and AST infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation for the mcDebug stem, defining how assertions become internalError reports and how debug text is conditionally emitted, whereas the same-named .def file merely declares those two utilities.
